title:
Same condo.
*Not every block is within 1km*

lines.say: You're buying a condo for the primary school nearby. But not every block in the same condo may be within 1km.
MOE measures from the school's boundary to the outline of your building.
So in a big condo, one block can fall inside 1km, while the block across the pool falls outside.
The category can also change from year to year, if school boundaries or building plans change.
Before you pick a unit, check the exact block on OneMap's school query, in the year you register.

caption:
